subject: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@zenith.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Zenith's pipeline and where you see opportunity to save on inference cost while hitting latency targets. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap of needs: low-latency chat for customer support (p95 < 250ms), batch embeddings for search (daily upsert 2M docs), strict data isolation for PII.
- What we showed: Redwood hosted API for quick POC, Dedicated pools for predictable throughput, Private deploy (VPC) for your regulated lines.
- Proposed next steps:
  1) Demo of Dedicated routing & cost controls (30–45min) — Marissa to schedule
  2) Share proposed pricing range and MOP (attached) — Marissa
  3) Security questionnaire kickoff if you want a deeper review — Dylan can lead

I've attached a short quickstart deck and a rough proposed MOP/pricing worksheet so you have something to review with the team (redwood-quickstart.pdf, zenith-proposed-pricing.xlsx).

Are you available for a demo week of July 12–16? If that window doesn't work, tell me a couple of good slots and I'll coordinate.

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Lee <jordan@zenith.ai>

Cc: Sana Patel <sana@zenith.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps & pricing

Thanks Marissa — really useful call. A few quick answers from our side:

- The support chat use-case is highest priority; latency target is firm.
- For the embeddings use-case we'll start with a scoped pilot (subset of docs) to validate relevance.
- Timeline: procurement pushed to early August (team availability), but we want a demo asap to line up stakeholders.

Can you run a demo the week of July 19? Prefer mornings PT. Also can you confirm whether the Dedicated pool would require long-term commit or if there's a short-term ramp option for the pilot?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Product Lead, Search
Zenith AI
